# **Privacy Policy**

## **1\. Introduction and scope**

Last updated: September 28, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how RedTeam Software, LLC and its Affiliates ("RedTeam," "we," "us" or "our") collect, use, share and protect information about you. Please read it carefully.

**What this policy covers.** It applies to information we collect:

1. On redteam.com, its subdomains and any other website we own or manage that links to this policy (the "Sites").
2. Through our products and services, including RedTeam Flex, RedTeam Go (formerly paskr), Fieldlens and Teamplayer, and the web, mobile and desktop applications that deliver them (together, the "Products").
3. In email, text and other electronic messages between you and RedTeam.
4. When you interact with our advertising or applications on third-party websites, if they link to this policy.

The Sites and Products together are the "Services." Section 4 covers terms that apply to only one Product.

**What it does not cover.** This policy does not apply to information we collect offline, or to websites and services run by third parties, including those linked from the Services.

**Definitions.** "Affiliates" means any Person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with RedTeam. "Control" means having the power, directly or indirectly, to direct the management and policies of a Person, whether through voting securities, other ownership interests or otherwise. "Person" means any individual, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, unincorporated organization or association, trust, or other business entity. "Personal Information" or "PI" is defined in Section 3.

**Your agreement.** By using the Services or giving us information, you agree to this policy. If you use the Services on behalf of an organization, "you" means both you and that organization. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

## **2\. Contact us**

If you have questions about this policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us at:

- Email: [legal@redteam.com](mailto:legal@redteam.com)
- Phone: (866) 432-2021
- Mail: RedTeam Software, LLC, 8623 Commodity Circle, Orlando, FL 32819

By using the Services or giving us PI, you agree that we may contact you electronically about legal, regulatory, technical, security, privacy and administrative matters related to your use of the Services.

## **3\. Information we collect**

We collect Personal Information that you give us, and usage information that we collect automatically when you use the Services.

**Personal Information you provide.** "Personal Information" or "PI" means information that identifies you or could be used to contact you. Examples include your name, company name, address, phone number, email address, username and password, and log-in dates. You provide PI when you:

- Fill out a form, request a demo, or contact us by email or phone.
- Register for an account or buy a Product.
- Upload content or use features of the Products (see Section 4).

**Payment information.** When you buy a Product, order and registration forms may ask for billing details, such as a credit card number, and demographic details, such as your zip code. We use a third-party payment processor, and we share your payment information with it and with your financial institution only to confirm, fulfill and bill your order.

**User Contributions.** Some Services let you post content in public areas or send it to other users or third parties ("User Contributions"). You post User Contributions at your own risk. We cannot control what other users do with them, and no security measure is perfect.

**Information collected automatically ("Usage Information").** When you use the Services, we automatically collect:

- Your IP address and internet domain.
- Browser type and language, operating system, and device and hardware information.
- The date, time and length of your visit.
- The pages you view and the search terms you use.
- Referring and exit pages.
- Product activity, crash reports and system settings.

Usage Information does not identify you by itself. However, if you log in, we may link it to your account. We use it mainly in aggregate, to learn how the Services are used and to improve them.

**Cookies and similar technologies.** We use the following:

- **Cookies:** small data files stored by your browser. They recognize your browser on return visits and help us understand how you use the Services. "Session" cookies expire when you close your browser. You can set your browser to refuse cookies, but some features may not work. See our [Cookie Policy](https://redteam.com/cookie-policy/) for a current list of the cookies we use and to change your cookie consent.
- **Pixel tags (web beacons):** tiny images embedded in pages and emails that tell us what content is effective.
- **Server logs:** records of requests to our servers, used to administer the Services and diagnose problems.

**Third-party advertising and analytics.** We allow advertising and analytics partners, including Google, Microsoft and Meta, to place cookies and pixels on the Sites. They collect information about your visits, such as the pages you view and the actions you take. They use it to measure how our Sites and ads perform, and to show you RedTeam ads on other websites. These partners may combine it with other information they have about you. Our marketing platform may also share contact information, including information collected through the Products, with advertising platforms (see Section 6). See Section 8 to opt out.

**Location information.** Some Products may collect information about your location. See Section 4 for what each Product collects.

## **4\. Product-specific terms**

The rest of this policy applies to every Product. This section adds terms that apply only to a specific Product. If this section conflicts with the rest of the policy, this section controls for that Product.

### **4.1 Fieldlens**

Fieldlens is owned and operated by RedTeam Software, LLC.

- **What we collect:** account and profile information for you and your team members.
- **Mobile and desktop apps:** this policy covers information collected through Fieldlens apps you download from the Sites or from app stores.
- **Reviewing and updating your information:** you can review and change your account information on your Fieldlens profile page. If you delete your User Contributions or your account, copies may remain visible to other users. Access to and use of User Contributions is governed by the [Fieldlens Terms of Use](https://redteam.com/userterms/).

### **4.2 RedTeam Go (formerly paskr)**

RedTeam Go is owned and operated by RedTeam Software, LLC. It was previously offered under the name "paskr."

- **What we collect:** account information, log information and information you enter into the Product.
- **Location information:** when you use RedTeam Go, we may collect and process information about your actual location. We use IP address, GPS and other device sensors, which may detect nearby devices and Wi-Fi access points.
- **Third-party integrators:** RedTeam Go may connect with other products and services through trusted third-party integrators. We share PI with those integrators only as needed to provide the features you use.
- **Service emails:** some emails are an integral part of RedTeam Go and have no unsubscribe link. To stop receiving them, stop using the Product.

## **5\. How we use your information**

We use the information we collect to:

- Provide the Services, set up and maintain your account, and complete the transactions you request.
- Verify your identity.
- Process payments and bill you for purchases.
- Respond to your questions and requests, and provide customer support.
- Provide features that work with third-party products and services you choose to connect.
- Send you Product updates, notices, and information about RedTeam or Affiliate products and offers that may interest you. You can opt out as described in Section 8.
- Ask for feedback about your experience with RedTeam.
- Improve the Services: fix technical problems, analyze trends and usage, and develop products and content.
- Keep the Services and our systems secure, and prevent fraud.
- Enforce our terms and agreements.
- Comply with law and meet legal, regulatory and contractual requirements.
- For any other purpose we describe when we collect the information, or with your consent.

## **6\. How we share your information**

**Sale and sharing for advertising.** We allow advertising and analytics partners, such as Google, Microsoft and Meta, to collect information through cookies and pixels on our Sites. We also send information, including some information collected through the Products, to our marketing platform, which shares it with advertising platforms. Under California and other state privacy laws, this is considered a "sale" of Personal Information or "sharing" it for targeted (cross-context behavioral) advertising. In the past 12 months, we have sold or shared the following:

| Category of PI | Third parties | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identifiers (IP address, cookie and device IDs) | Advertising networks, social media platforms, analytics providers | Targeted advertising, ad measurement |
| Internet activity (pages viewed, clicks, interactions with the Sites) | Advertising networks, social media platforms, analytics providers | Targeted advertising, ad measurement |
| Approximate location (based on IP address) | Advertising networks, social media platforms, analytics providers | Targeted advertising, ad measurement |
| Contact information in customer lists (name, company name and email address) | Advertising networks and social media platforms, through our marketing platform | Building ad audiences, matching you to accounts on those platforms |
| Conversion events (such as form submissions, meetings booked, and changes in customer or deal status) | Advertising networks and social media platforms, through our marketing platform | Ad measurement and optimization |

We never sell or share SMS opt-in data. We do not knowingly sell or share the PI of anyone under 16. To opt out, see Section 8.

We may share aggregated or de-identified information, which does not identify any individual, without restriction. We may share Personal Information:

- **With our Affiliates and subsidiaries.**
- **With service providers** we use to support our business, such as hosting, payment processing, analytics and customer support. They may use it only to provide those services to us.
- **With third-party integrators** you choose to connect to the Products (see Section 4).
- **With RedTeam Partners**, as described in Section 9.
- **To carry out your requests**, for example when you invite other people to use the Services.
- **In a business transfer.** If RedTeam or its assets are sold or transferred, including through a merger, acquisition, reorganization, bankruptcy or liquidation, your information may be among the assets transferred. The buyer or transferee must honor the commitments in this policy.
- **With your consent**, or for any other purpose we disclose when you provide the information. This does not apply to SMS opt-in data (see "Text messaging (SMS)" below).

**Legally required disclosure.** We may disclose PI if the law requires it, or if we believe in good faith that disclosure is reasonably necessary to:

1. Comply with legal process or a government request.
2. Enforce our agreements, including our Terms of Use.
3. Act on suspected illegal activity.
4. Protect the rights, property or safety of RedTeam, our Affiliates, our users or the public, including by exchanging information with other organizations to prevent fraud.

In some circumstances, courts such as U.S. Bankruptcy Courts may allow your PI to be transferred to third parties without your permission.

**Text messaging (SMS).** If you opt in to receive text messages from RedTeam, we collect your mobile phone number and your consent to receive texts ("SMS opt-in data").

- **No sharing of SMS opt-in data:** we will not share, sell, rent or otherwise disclose your mobile information or SMS opt-in data to any third parties or Affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.
- **No sharing, even with your consent:** every category of sharing described in this policy excludes SMS opt-in data. We will not share that data with any third party, even if you consent to it.
- **Service providers:** we share mobile information only with the service providers that deliver our text messages, such as our messaging platform provider, and only so they can provide the SMS service to you.
- **Opting out:** you can stop receiving texts at any time by replying STOP. Reply HELP for help. Message and data rates may apply, and message frequency varies.
- **For full program details**, see our [SMS Terms & Conditions](https://redteam.com/sms-terms/).

## **7\. Retention, storage and security**

**Retention.** We keep PI for as long as we need it for the purposes it was collected for, and as required to comply with the law. This may continue after your relationship with RedTeam ends.

**Storage in the United States.** We store and process PI in the United States. U.S. data protection laws may differ from, and be less strict than, the laws where you live.

**How we protect your information.** We use physical, electronic and procedural safeguards to protect PI from loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration and disclosure. For example:

- We limit access to PI to employees, Affiliates, service providers and integrators who need it to provide the Services or run our business.
- We train our employees on protecting customer data and on our confidentiality policies.
- We ask our service providers and integrators to maintain their own data security policies.

No method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. We also cannot guarantee that the security measures of third-party service providers or integrators will be sufficient or never fail. You send information to us at your own risk. We are not responsible for anyone getting around the privacy settings or security measures in the Services.

**Your password.** If you have a password for the Services, keep it confidential and do not share it with anyone.

## **8\. Your choices and rights**

**Accessing and correcting your information.** You can review and update your account information in your Product profile. You can also contact us (Section 2) to ask for a summary of the PI we hold about you, or to ask us to correct, update or delete it. We will respond as allowed by law and our agreements with partners.

**Marketing emails.** To stop receiving marketing emails, use the "unsubscribe" link in any such email or contact us at [legal@redteam.com](mailto:legal@redteam.com). Service emails that are part of a Product may not have an unsubscribe link (see Section 4).

**Do Not Track.** The Services do not respond to Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals. You can use your browser settings to block or delete cookies and web beacons. You can opt out of interest-based advertising from participating companies through the Digital Advertising Alliance at [aboutads.info/choices](http://www.aboutads.info/choices/).

**U.S. state privacy rights.** Depending on where you live, state privacy laws may give you the rights below.

- **California (CCPA, as amended by the CPRA):** you can ask to know what PI we collect, use and disclose. You can also ask us to delete or correct it, opt out of its "sale" or "sharing," and limit our use of sensitive PI. We will not discriminate against you for using these rights.
- **California "Shine the Light" (Civil Code § 1798.83):** you can ask what PI we shared with third parties for their direct marketing in the previous calendar year, and with whom. We do not share PI for that purpose.
- **Other states:** Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah and Virginia have similar laws. Rights generally include access, correction, deletion and data portability. They also include opting out of targeted advertising, the sale of PI, and certain profiling.
- **Appeals:** if we deny your request, you can appeal by contacting us.
- **How to make a request:** contact us (Section 2). We will verify your identity before responding. An authorized agent may submit a request on your behalf. We will respond within the time the law requires, usually 45 days.

**Opting out of sale and sharing.** You can opt out by clicking "Your Privacy Choices" (or "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information") in the footer of our Sites, or by contacting us. We treat Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals as a valid opt-out request for the browser or device that sends them.

## **9\. International users**

If you are a non-US resident, please be advised that we may transfer information that we collect about you, including your PI, to a RedTeam Partner across borders and from your country or jurisdiction to other countries or jurisdictions around the world. If you are visiting from the European Union or other regions with laws governing data collection and use that may differ from U.S. law, please note that you are transferring information about you, including PI, to a country and jurisdiction that does not have the same data protection laws as the European Union. Accordingly, you consent to the transfer of information about you, including your PI, to the U.S., and the use and disclosure of information about you, including your PI, as described in this Privacy Policy.

**Who is a RedTeam Partner?**

A RedTeam Partner is a channel partner, who has a signed agreement with RedTeam, allowing them to sell RedTeam's solutions.

A RedTeam Partner has both existing primary service relationships and is actively seeking new primary service relationships with customers that may be interested in subscriptions for RedTeam Services.

If you are located outside the United States, your information may be shared with a RedTeam Partner to provide you with local services and support.

## **10\. Children**

The Services are not directed to, or intended for, anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect PI from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has given us information, contact us at [legal@redteam.com](mailto:legal@redteam.com). We will delete that information and close the associated account.

## **11\. Third-party sites and social media**

**Third-party sites.** The Services may link to websites we do not operate. We are not responsible for their content, privacy policies or practices, and a link does not mean we endorse them. Please review each site's privacy policy before giving it your information.

**Social media and public features.** Information you submit through a social media platform, or post in a public area of the Services (such as a message board or chat), may be seen and used by others. You share it at your own risk and should not expect privacy. Please be careful about sharing PI in these areas. When you reach the Services through a social media platform, that platform's privacy policy and terms also apply.

## **12\. Changes to this policy**

We may update this policy from time to time. We will post the updated policy on this page with a new "Last updated" date. If we make a material change to how we handle PI, we will also notify you at the email address on your account. If you keep using the Services after a change, you accept the updated policy.
